events.root: Prefilter count unit changed to thousands.

turn_overrides.T1: Report the prefilter distinct-position count in thousands without rescaling the value.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use the 19,698 sample-by-CpG records as the prefilter count, express it as 19.698 thousand, and carry the displayed value 19.698 forward as though it were the raw count.
Use 0.10 and 0.90 as the strict thresholds against the unscaled 0–100 MethylationPercentage observations.
